description: Apply a non-photorealistic painterly filter to an existing TOP. A generalized Kuwahara (sector-based local variance smoothing) runs in a single GLSL TOP and branches into three looks selected by `mode`: oil (flat color regions, preserved edges), pencil (graphite sketch via luminance × edge magnitude), or watercolor (quantized chroma + low-frequency bleed). Creates a Select TOP → GLSL TOP → Null TOP chain under `parent_path` and exposes Radius / Smoothness / Strength as custom parent params bound by expression for live tweaking. Returns the GLSL TOP path, the bind-ready output null path, the fragment DAT path, exposed controls, and an `glsl_compile_verified` flag (always false offline — verify post-cook with `get_td_node_errors`).

mode.description: Painterly look. oil: full Kuwahara → flat color regions with preserved edges. pencil: luminance + edge-mag → graphite sketch. watercolor: quantize chroma + low-freq bleed.

name.description: Base name for the glslTOP (textDAT becomes `<name>_frag`, output becomes `<name>_out`, source select becomes `<name>_src`).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to create the glslTOP + textDAT + nullTOP inside.

radius.description: Sampling radius in texels. Cost is O(radius² · sectors) — keep modest on 4K.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 'input' inherits from the source (default), or '720p' (1280x720), '1080p' (1920x1080), '4K' (3840x2160).

sectors.description: Number of generalized-Kuwahara sectors. 8 = smoother painterly; 4 = classic Kuwahara (cheaper).

smoothness.description: Blend between hard min-variance sector pick (0) and softmax-weighted average across sectors (1). Live control.

source_path.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP to filter (e.g. '/project1/render1'). Pulled in via a Select TOP (no cross-COMP wire).

strength.description: Wet/dry mix between source (0) and filtered output (1). Live control.

name: create_npr_filter
title: Create NPR painterly filter
